clauses: Article 189 establishes the statutory provisions governing decisions of supreme court binding on other courts under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Action in aid of Supreme Court
salient_points: Mandates that all executive and judicial authorities throughout Pakistan shall act in aid of the Supreme Court.
clauses: Article 190 establishes the statutory provisions governing action in aid of supreme court under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Rules of procedure
salient_points: Empowers Supreme Court to make rules regulating court practice and procedure.
clauses: Article 191 establishes the statutory provisions governing rules of procedure under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Constitutional Benches of the Supreme Court
salient_points: Inserted by 26th Amendment, 2024; augmented by 27th Amendment, 2025. Establishes dedicated Constitutional Benches of the Supreme Court to exclusively hear matters arising under Article 184, 185 (constitutional interpretations), and advisory references under Article 186.
clauses: Article 191A establishes the statutory provisions governing constitutional benches of the supreme court under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Constitution of High Court
salient_points: Establishes composition of a High Court: Chief Justice and such other Judges as determined by law.
clauses: Article 192 establishes the statutory provisions governing constitution of high court under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Appointment of High Court Judges
salient_points: Prescribes qualifications for High Court Judges: citizenship, minimum age 45, and 10 years as advocate or 10 years judicial service.
clauses: Article 193 establishes the statutory provisions governing appointment of high court judges under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Oath of office
salient_points: Requires Chief Justice of High Court to take oath before Governor, and other Judges before Chief Justice.
clauses: Article 194 establishes the statutory provisions governing oath of office under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Retiring age
salient_points: Fixes superannuation retirement age of High Court Judges at 62 years.
clauses: Article 195 establishes the statutory provisions governing retiring age under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Acting Chief Justice
salient_points: Regulates appointment of Acting Chief Justice of High Court.
clauses: Article 196 establishes the statutory provisions governing acting chief justice under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Additional Judges
salient_points: Regulates appointment of Additional Judges of High Courts.
clauses: Article 197 establishes the statutory provisions governing additional judges under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Seat of the High Court
salient_points: Designates principal seats and circuit benches of High Courts across provincial divisional headquarters.
clauses: Article 198 establishes the statutory provisions governing seat of the high court under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Jurisdiction of High Court
salient_points: Constitutional writ jurisdiction: empowers High Courts to issue writs of prohibition, mandamus, certiorari, habeas corpus, and quo warranto, and enforce fundamental rights against unlawful state actions.
clauses: Article 199 establishes the statutory provisions governing jurisdiction of high court under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Transfer of High Court Judges
salient_points: Regulates transfer of High Court Judges from one High Court to another.
clauses: Article 200 establishes the statutory provisions governing transfer of high court judges under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Decision of High Court binding on subordinate courts
salient_points: Establishes that decisions of a High Court on questions of law are binding on all subordinate courts within its territorial jurisdiction.
clauses: Article 201 establishes the statutory provisions governing decision of high court binding on subordinate courts under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Rules of procedure
salient_points: Empowers High Courts to make rules regulating court practice and subordinate court supervision.
clauses: Article 202 establishes the statutory provisions governing rules of procedure under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Constitutional Benches of High Courts
salient_points: Inserted by 26th Amendment, 2024. Establishes dedicated Constitutional Benches in each High Court to hear writ petitions involving substantial questions of constitutional interpretation.
clauses: Article 202A establishes the statutory provisions governing constitutional benches of high courts under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: High Court to superintend subordinate courts
salient_points: Gives each High Court administrative superintendence and control over all courts subordinate to it in the Province.
clauses: Article 203 establishes the statutory provisions governing high court to superintend subordinate courts under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Provisions of Chapter to have effect notwithstanding other provisions
salient_points: Non-obstante clause giving Chapter 3A effect notwithstanding anything contained in the Constitution.
clauses: Article 203A establishes the statutory provisions governing provisions of chapter to have effect notwithstanding other provisions under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Definitions
salient_points: Defines 'law' for the purposes of the Federal Shariat Court (excluding Constitution, Muslim personal law, and procedural laws).
clauses: Article 203B establishes the statutory provisions governing definitions under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: The Federal Shariat Court
salient_points: Establishes Federal Shariat Court: Chief Justice and up to seven Muslim Judges (including Ulema judges qualified in Islamic law).
clauses: Article 203C establishes the statutory provisions governing the federal shariat court under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Powers, jurisdiction and functions of the Court
salient_points: Empowers FSC (suo motu or on petition) to examine whether any law is repugnant to the Injunctions of Islam.
clauses: Article 203D establishes the statutory provisions governing powers, jurisdiction and functions of the court under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Revisional and other jurisdiction of the Court
salient_points: Vests revisional and appellate criminal jurisdiction over Hudood cases.
clauses: Article 203DD establishes the statutory provisions governing revisional and other jurisdiction of the court under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Powers and procedure of the Court
salient_points: Regulates FSC powers to summon witnesses, require discovery, and appoint jurisconsults.
clauses: Article 203E establishes the statutory provisions governing powers and procedure of the court under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Appeal to Supreme Court
salient_points: Provides right of appeal against FSC decisions to the Shariat Appellate Bench of the Supreme Court.
clauses: Article 203F establishes the statutory provisions governing appeal to supreme court under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Bar of jurisdiction
salient_points: Bars other courts from entertaining matters within the jurisdiction of the Federal Shariat Court.
clauses: Article 203G establishes the statutory provisions governing bar of jurisdiction under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Pending proceedings to continue, etc.
salient_points: Transitional provisions regarding pending Shariat petitions.
clauses: Article 203H establishes the statutory provisions governing pending proceedings to continue, etc. under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Administrative arrangements
salient_points: Repealed/Omitted.
clauses: Article 203I establishes the statutory provisions governing administrative arrangements under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Power to make rules
salient_points: Empowers FSC to make rules regulating its practice and procedure.
clauses: Article 203J establishes the statutory provisions governing power to make rules under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Contempt of Court
salient_points: Constitutional contempt power: empowers Supreme Court and High Courts to punish any person who abuses, interferes with, or scandalizes the court, or disobeys any order.
clauses: Article 204 establishes the statutory provisions governing contempt of court under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Remuneration, etc., of Judges
salient_points: Guarantees that remuneration and privileges of superior court Judges shall be as specified in the Fifth Schedule and cannot be varied to their disadvantage.
clauses: Article 205 establishes the statutory provisions governing remuneration, etc., of judges under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Resignation
salient_points: Regulates resignation of superior court Judges.
clauses: Article 206 establishes the statutory provisions governing resignation under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Judge not to hold office of profit, etc.
salient_points: Disqualifies sitting Judges from holding offices of profit, and imposes post-retirement restrictions on practicing before courts where they served.
clauses: Article 207 establishes the statutory provisions governing judge not to hold office of profit, etc. under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Officers and servants of Courts
salient_points: Empowers superior courts to appoint officers and make internal service rules with presidential or gubernatorial approval.
clauses: Article 208 establishes the statutory provisions governing officers and servants of courts under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Supreme Judicial Council
salient_points: Constitutional peer accountability body: composed of CJP, two senior-most Supreme Court Judges, and two senior-most High Court Chief Justices. Inquires into physical/mental incapacity or misconduct of superior court judges.
clauses: Article 209 establishes the statutory provisions governing supreme judicial council under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Power of Council to enforce attendance, etc.
salient_points: Vests Supreme Judicial Council with powers of a Supreme Court to enforce attendance and order discovery.
clauses: Article 210 establishes the statutory provisions governing power of council to enforce attendance, etc. under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Bar of jurisdiction
salient_points: Bars any court from questioning proceedings, reports, or advice of the Supreme Judicial Council or the President's removal orders.
clauses: Article 211 establishes the statutory provisions governing bar of jurisdiction under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Administrative Courts and Tribunals
salient_points: Authorizes establishment of specialized Administrative Courts and Tribunals (e.g. Federal/Provincial Service Tribunals) for civil servants and revenue matters, excluding ordinary High Court writ jurisdiction.
clauses: Article 212 establishes the statutory provisions governing administrative courts and tribunals under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Military Courts
salient_points: Repealed/Omitted.
clauses: Article 212A establishes the statutory provisions governing military courts under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Establishment of Special Courts for trial of heinous offences
salient_points: Repealed following expiration of 3-year sunset under 12th Amendment, 1991.
clauses: Article 212B establishes the statutory provisions governing establishment of special courts for trial of heinous offences under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Chief Election Commissioner
salient_points: Provides for appointment of Chief Election Commissioner by consensus between Prime Minister and Leader of the Opposition (or bipartisan parliamentary committee). Qualifications broadened by 22nd Amendment.
clauses: Article 213 establishes the statutory provisions governing chief election commissioner under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Oath of office
salient_points: Requires Commissioner to take oath before Chief Justice of Pakistan.
clauses: Article 214 establishes the statutory provisions governing oath of office under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Term of office of Commissioner
salient_points: Fixes term of Commissioner and ECP members at five years; removable only through Supreme Judicial Council procedure.
clauses: Article 215 establishes the statutory provisions governing term of office of commissioner under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Commissioner and members not to hold office of profit
salient_points: Disqualifies Commissioner and members from holding offices of profit during and for two years after tenure.
clauses: Article 216 establishes the statutory provisions governing commissioner and members not to hold office of profit under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Acting Commissioner
salient_points: Provides for senior-most ECP member to act as Commissioner during vacancy.
clauses: Article 217 establishes the statutory provisions governing acting commissioner under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Election Commission
salient_points: Constitutionalizes the Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP): Commissioner and four members, one from each Province. Mandates ECP to organize and conduct elections honestly, justly, fairly and in accordance with law, guarding against corrupt practices.
clauses: Article 218 establishes the statutory provisions governing election commission under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Duties of Commission
salient_points: Enumerates ECP constitutional duties: electoral rolls, conducting elections to Senate, National Assembly, Provincial Assemblies, and Local Governments, and hearing disqualification references.
clauses: Article 219 establishes the statutory provisions governing duties of commission under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Executive authorities to assist Commission
salient_points: Mandates that all executive authorities in the Federation and Provinces shall assist the Commissioner and ECP in discharge of their functions.
clauses: Article 220 establishes the statutory provisions governing executive authorities to assist commission under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Officers and servants
salient_points: Empowers ECP to appoint its own officers and make service rules.
clauses: Article 221 establishes the statutory provisions governing officers and servants under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Electoral laws
salient_points: Empowers Parliament to enact laws regulating constituency delimitation, electoral rolls, election petitions, and conduct of elections.
clauses: Article 222 establishes the statutory provisions governing electoral laws under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Bar against double membership
salient_points: Strict bar against double membership: no person can simultaneously be a member of both Houses or of a House and a Provincial Assembly.
clauses: Article 223 establishes the statutory provisions governing bar against double membership under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Time of Election and prelude to elections
salient_points: Mandates general elections within 60 days of normal assembly expiration, or within 90 days following dissolution. Governs appointment of neutral Caretaker Prime Minister and Chief Ministers.
clauses: Article 224 establishes the statutory provisions governing time of election and prelude to elections under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Resolution by Committee or Election Commission
salient_points: Inserted by 20th Amendment, 2012. Provides deadlock resolution mechanism: if PM and Opposition Leader cannot agree on Caretaker PM within 3 days, matter goes to an 8-member bipartisan Parliamentary Committee; if committee deadlocks, ECP appoints Caretaker PM within 2 days.
clauses: Article 224A establishes the statutory provisions governing resolution by committee or election commission under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Election dispute
salient_points: Bars ordinary court challenges: no election to a House or Provincial Assembly shall be called in question except by an election petition presented to an Election Tribunal.
clauses: Article 225 establishes the statutory provisions governing election dispute under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Election by secret ballot
salient_points: Mandates that all elections under the Constitution, other than those of the Prime Minister and Chief Minister, shall be by secret ballot.
clauses: Article 226 establishes the statutory provisions governing election by secret ballot under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Provisions relating to the Holy Quran and Sunnah
salient_points: Mandates that all existing laws shall be brought into conformity with the Injunctions of Islam as laid down in the Holy Quran and Sunnah, and no law shall be enacted which is repugnant to such Injunctions. Protects personal laws of non-Muslim citizens and distinct sects.
clauses: Article 227 establishes the statutory provisions governing provisions relating to the holy quran and sunnah under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Composition, etc., of Islamic Council
salient_points: Establishes the Council of Islamic Ideology (CII): 8 to 20 members representing various schools of thought, including women, scholars, and judicial figures.
clauses: Article 228 establishes the statutory provisions governing composition, etc., of islamic council under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Reference by Majlis-e-Shoora, etc. to Islamic Council
salient_points: Empowers President, Governor, or two-fifths of parliamentarians/MPAs to refer a proposed bill to the CII for advice on whether it is repugnant to Islamic injunctions.
clauses: Article 229 establishes the statutory provisions governing reference by majlis-e-shoora, etc. to islamic council under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Functions of the Islamic Council
salient_points: Enumerates CII advisory functions: recommending measures to bring laws into conformity with Islam, advising legislature on references, and compiling annual reports.
clauses: Article 230 establishes the statutory provisions governing functions of the islamic council under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Rules of procedure
salient_points: Empowers Council of Islamic Ideology to make rules regulating its proceedings.
clauses: Article 231 establishes the statutory provisions governing rules of procedure under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Proclamation of emergency on account of war, internal disturbance, etc.
salient_points: Empowers President to issue a Proclamation of Emergency if security of Pakistan is threatened by war, external aggression, or internal disturbance. Requires Provincial Assembly resolution for internal disturbance emergency; subject to parliamentary approval within 30 days.
clauses: Article 232 establishes the statutory provisions governing proclamation of emergency on account of war, internal disturbance, etc. under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Power to suspend Fundamental Rights, etc., during emergency period
salient_points: Governs suspension of fundamental rights during emergency: Articles 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, and 24 may be suspended by presidential order; core rights under Articles 9, 10, 10A, 14, 25, 25A cannot be suspended.
clauses: Article 233 establishes the statutory provisions governing power to suspend fundamental rights, etc., during emergency period under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Power to issue Proclamation in case of failure of constitutional machinery in a Province
salient_points: Governor's rule / Federal takeover: empowers President, on receipt of report from Governor, to assume provincial government functions if governance cannot be carried on in accordance with Constitution. Subject to strict two-month parliamentary approval and six-month absolute limit.
clauses: Article 234 establishes the statutory provisions governing power to issue proclamation in case of failure of constitutional machinery in a province under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Proclamation in case of financial emergency
salient_points: Authorizes President to proclaim financial emergency if economic life or financial stability is threatened; permits federal salary reductions.
clauses: Article 235 establishes the statutory provisions governing proclamation in case of financial emergency under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Revocation of Proclamation, etc.
salient_points: Provides for revocation or variation of emergency proclamations by subsequent proclamation.
clauses: Article 236 establishes the statutory provisions governing revocation of proclamation, etc. under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Majlis-e-Shoora may make laws indemnifying, etc.
salient_points: Empowers Parliament to make laws indemnifying state officers in respect of acts done during martial law or emergency for maintenance of order.
clauses: Article 237 establishes the statutory provisions governing majlis-e-shoora may make laws indemnifying, etc. under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Amendment of Constitution
salient_points: Establishes that the Constitution may be amended by an Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) in the manner provided in this Part.
clauses: Article 238 establishes the statutory provisions governing amendment of constitution under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Constitution amendment Bill
salient_points: Rigid amendment procedure: requires a two-thirds majority of the total membership in each House of Parliament. Crucially, clause (4) mandates: where a bill would alter the limits of a Province, it cannot be presented to the President for assent unless passed by the Provincial Assembly of that Province by at least a two-thirds majority of its total membership.
clauses: (1) A Bill to amend the Constitution may originate in either House and, when the Bill has been passed by the votes of not less than two-thirds of the total membership of the House, it shall be transmitted to the other House.

(2) If the Bill is passed without amendment by the votes of not less than two-thirds of the total membership of the House to which it is transmitted... it shall be presented to the President for assent.

(4) A Bill to amend the Constitution which would have the effect of altering the limits of a Province shall not be presented to the President for assent unless it has been passed by the Provincial Assembly of that Province by the votes of not less than two-thirds of its total membership.
(5) No amendment of the Constitution shall be called in question in any court on any ground whatsoever.
(6) For the removal of doubt, it is hereby declared that there is no limitation whatever on the power of the Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) to amend any of the provisions of the Constitution.

title: Appointments to service of Pakistan and conditions of service
salient_points: Regulates appointments and service conditions of civil servants: determined by Act of Parliament for federal services, and by Act of Provincial Assembly for provincial civil services.
clauses: Article 240 establishes the statutory provisions governing appointments to service of pakistan and conditions of service under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Existing rules, etc., to continue
salient_points: Provides continuity of existing civil service rules until superseded by Acts of Parliament or Assemblies.
clauses: Article 241 establishes the statutory provisions governing existing rules, etc., to continue under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Public Service Commission
salient_points: Provides for Federal Public Service Commission (FPSC) and Provincial Public Service Commissions (PPSC, SPSC, KPPSC, BPSC) for competitive merit-based recruitment to civil posts.
clauses: Article 242 establishes the statutory provisions governing public service commission under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Command of Armed Forces
salient_points: Vests supreme command of the Armed Forces in the President. Federal Government exercises control and command. President appoints Chairman Joint Chiefs of Staff Committee and Chiefs of Army, Naval, and Air Staff on binding advice of Prime Minister.
clauses: Article 243 establishes the statutory provisions governing command of armed forces under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Oath of Armed Forces
salient_points: Prescribes solemn oath for Armed Forces personnel set out in Third Schedule: swear to uphold Constitution and not engage in any political activities whatsoever.
clauses: Article 244 establishes the statutory provisions governing oath of armed forces under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Functions of Armed Forces
salient_points: Delineates Armed Forces duties: defend Pakistan against external aggression or threat of war, and, subject to law, act in aid of civil power when called upon by the Federal Government.
clauses: Article 245 establishes the statutory provisions governing functions of armed forces under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Tribal Areas
salient_points: Amended by 25th Amendment, 2018: reflects merger of FATA into Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province.
clauses: Article 246 establishes the statutory provisions governing tribal areas under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Administration of Tribal Areas
salient_points: Omitted by 25th Amendment, 2018. Former special administrative regime of FATA under President/Governor is abolished.
clauses: Article 247 establishes the statutory provisions governing administration of tribal areas under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Protection to President, Governor, Minister, etc.
salient_points: Provides official immunity: President, Governor, Prime Minister, Federal/Provincial Ministers are not answerable to any court for exercise of powers; no criminal proceedings can be instituted against President or Governor while in office.
clauses: Article 248 establishes the statutory provisions governing protection to president, governor, minister, etc. under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Legal proceedings
salient_points: Regulates legal proceedings against the Federation or Provinces.
clauses: Article 249 establishes the statutory provisions governing legal proceedings under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Salaries, allowances, etc., of the President, etc.
salient_points: Regulates terms of office and salaries of President, Governors, Speaker, CJP, and other constitutional office-holders.
clauses: Article 250 establishes the statutory provisions governing salaries, allowances, etc., of the president, etc. under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: National language
salient_points: Designates Urdu as the national language of Pakistan, directs arrangements for its use for official and other purposes, and permits Provincial Assemblies to prescribe measures for teaching and promotion of provincial languages.
clauses: Article 251 establishes the statutory provisions governing national language under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Special provisions in relation to major ports and aerodromes
salient_points: Empowers President to make special exemptions for major ports and airports.
clauses: Article 252 establishes the statutory provisions governing special provisions in relation to major ports and aerodromes under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Maximum limits as to property, etc.
salient_points: Empowers Parliament to enact laws setting maximum limits on property ownership and declaring state ownership of commercial/industrial enterprises.
clauses: Article 253 establishes the statutory provisions governing maximum limits as to property, etc. under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Failure to comply with requirement as to time does not render an act invalid
salient_points: General saving provision: an act required to be done within a particular period is not rendered invalid merely because it was done after that period.
clauses: Article 254 establishes the statutory provisions governing failure to comply with requirement as to time does not render an act invalid under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Oath of office
salient_points: General provisions on administration and forms of constitutional oaths.
clauses: Article 255 establishes the statutory provisions governing oath of office under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Private armies forbidden
salient_points: Strictly forbids private armies: no private organization capable of functioning as a military or paramilitary organization shall be formed, and any such organization is illegal.
clauses: Article 256 establishes the statutory provisions governing private armies forbidden under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Provision relating to the State of Jammu and Kashmir
salient_points: Constitutionalizes Kashmir policy: when the people of Jammu and Kashmir decide to accede to Pakistan, the relationship between Pakistan and that State shall be determined in accordance with the wishes of the people of that State.
clauses: Article 257 establishes the statutory provisions governing provision relating to the state of jammu and kashmir under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Government of certain areas by Order of the President
salient_points: Empowers President to make orders for government and administration of territories outside the four Provinces.
clauses: Article 258 establishes the statutory provisions governing government of certain areas by order of the president under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Awards
salient_points: Prohibits grant of titles, honours, and decorations by the State except for gallantry, merit in public service, or academic distinction.
clauses: Article 259 establishes the statutory provisions governing awards under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Definitions
salient_points: Comprehensive constitutional dictionary defining essential legal terms, including 'citizen', 'Act of Parliament', 'Provincial law', 'service of Pakistan', and definitions of Muslim and non-Muslim.
clauses: Article 260 establishes the statutory provisions governing definitions under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Person acting in office not to be regarded as its holder, etc.
salient_points: Interpretation rule regarding persons acting temporarily in constitutional offices.
clauses: Article 261 establishes the statutory provisions governing person acting in office not to be regarded as its holder, etc. under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Gregorian calendar to be used
salient_points: Mandates that the reckoning of calendar years and months for constitutional purposes shall be according to the Gregorian calendar.
clauses: Article 262 establishes the statutory provisions governing gregorian calendar to be used under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Gender and number
salient_points: Standard statutory interpretation rule: words importing the masculine gender include females, and singular includes plural.
clauses: Article 263 establishes the statutory provisions governing gender and number under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Effect of repeal of laws
salient_points: Specifies the legal effect of constitutional or statutory repeal: does not revive anything not in force, affect previous operation, or affect acquired rights.
clauses: Article 264 establishes the statutory provisions governing effect of repeal of laws under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Title of Constitution and commencement
salient_points: Specifies that this Constitution shall be known as the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, and came into force on the 14th day of August, 1973.
clauses: Article 265 establishes the statutory provisions governing title of constitution and commencement under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Repeal
salient_points: Repealed the Interim Constitution of 1972 upon commencement of the 1973 permanent Constitution.
clauses: Article 266 establishes the statutory provisions governing repeal under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Power of President to remove difficulties
salient_points: Transitional power of President to adapt provisions for smooth initial constitutional transition.
clauses: Article 267 establishes the statutory provisions governing power of president to remove difficulties under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Power to remove difficulties (18th Amendment)
salient_points: Empowered President, on PM's advice, to remove transitional implementation difficulties of the 18th Amendment within one year.
clauses: Article 267A establishes the statutory provisions governing power to remove difficulties (18th amendment) under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Removal of difficulties (20th Amendment)
salient_points: Transitional power for 20th Amendment implementation.
clauses: Article 267B establishes the statutory provisions governing removal of difficulties (20th amendment) under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Continuance in force, and adaptation of certain laws
salient_points: Provides for the continuance of existing laws in force until altered, repealed, or amended by the competent legislature.
clauses: Article 268 establishes the statutory provisions governing continuance in force, and adaptation of certain laws under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Validation of laws, acts, etc.
salient_points: Transitional validation of laws enacted between March 1969 and April 1972.
clauses: Article 269 establishes the statutory provisions governing validation of laws, acts, etc. under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Temporary validation of certain laws, etc.
salient_points: Temporary validation clause.
clauses: Article 270 establishes the statutory provisions governing temporary validation of certain laws, etc. under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Affirmation of President's Orders, etc. (8th Amendment)
salient_points: Historical indemnity clause enacted by 8th Amendment validating laws, martial law regulations, and President's Orders made between July 1977 and December 1985.
clauses: Article 270A establishes the statutory provisions governing affirmation of president's orders, etc. (8th amendment) under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Declaration and continuance of laws etc. (18th Amendment overhaul)
salient_points: Enacted by the 18th Amendment, 2010: declared the proclamation of emergency of 3 November 2007, Provisional Constitution Order (PCO), and unconstitutional acts of General Pervez Musharraf to be void ab initio and without lawful authority.
clauses: Article 270AA establishes the statutory provisions governing declaration and continuance of laws etc. (18th amendment overhaul) under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Elections to be deemed to be held under Constitution
salient_points: Validates the 1977 and 1985 general elections for transitional continuity.
clauses: Article 270B establishes the statutory provisions governing elections to be deemed to be held under constitution under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: General Elections 2008
salient_points: Deems the 2008 General Elections to have been held under the Constitution.
clauses: Article 270BB establishes the statutory provisions governing general elections 2008 under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: First National Assembly
salient_points: Provided for the National Assembly in existence before commencement day to be the first National Assembly under the 1973 Constitution.
clauses: Article 271 establishes the statutory provisions governing first national assembly under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: First Senate
salient_points: Regulated the transitional constitution and staggered terms of the first Senate of Pakistan.
clauses: Article 272 establishes the statutory provisions governing first senate under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: First Provincial Assembly
salient_points: Provided for transitional Provincial Assemblies.
clauses: Article 273 establishes the statutory provisions governing first provincial assembly under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Vesting of property, assets, rights, liabilities and obligations
salient_points: Regulates legal succession of property, assets, contracts, and liabilities from previous constitutional regimes.
clauses: Article 274 establishes the statutory provisions governing vesting of property, assets, rights, liabilities and obligations under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Continuance in office of persons in service of Pakistan, etc.
salient_points: Provided for civil servants and judges holding office to continue serving under the new Constitution.
clauses: Article 275 establishes the statutory provisions governing continuance in office of persons in service of pakistan, etc. under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Oath of first President
salient_points: Regulated the oath of the first President of Pakistan under the 1973 Constitution.
clauses: Article 276 establishes the statutory provisions governing oath of first president under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Transitional financial provisions
salient_points: Authorized public expenditures during the initial transitional financial year.
clauses: Article 277 establishes the statutory provisions governing transitional financial provisions under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Accounts and audit
salient_points: Transitional accounting arrangements.
clauses: Article 278 establishes the statutory provisions governing accounts and audit under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Continuance of taxes
salient_points: Continued existing taxes and duties until altered by legislative Acts.
clauses: Article 279 establishes the statutory provisions governing continuance of taxes under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Continuance of Proclamation of Emergency
salient_points: Continued the 1971 state of emergency into the commencement of the 1973 Constitution.
clauses: Article 280 establishes the statutory provisions governing continuance of proclamation of emergency under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Laws exempted from the operation of Article 8(1) and (2)
salient_points: Enumerates specific statutory laws, President's Orders, and defense-related regulations that are permanently exempted from being declared void under fundamental rights (Article 8).
clauses: Article First Schedule establishes the statutory provisions governing laws exempted from the operation of article 8(1) and (2) under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Election of President
salient_points: Detailed proportional voting procedure for presidential elections by the joint Electoral College consisting of Parliament and the four Provincial Assemblies.
clauses: Article Second Schedule establishes the statutory provisions governing election of president under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Oaths of Office
salient_points: Exact constitutional texts of solemn oaths of office for President, Prime Minister, Federal Ministers, Speaker, Chairman Senate, Governors, Chief Ministers, Judges, and Armed Forces.
clauses: Article Third Schedule establishes the statutory provisions governing oaths of office under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Legislative Lists
salient_points: The division of powers blueprint: contains the Federal Legislative List (Part I: exclusive federal powers like defense, foreign affairs, currency, nationality; Part II: Council of Common Interests subjects like railways, mineral oil, electricity). Concurrent Legislative List was abolished by the 18th Amendment, devolving all residual matters to the Provinces.
clauses: Article Fourth Schedule establishes the statutory provisions governing legislative lists under the Constitution of Pakistan.

title: Remuneration and Terms and Conditions of Service of Judges
salient_points: Fixes official salaries, pensions, housing allowances, and travel privileges for the Chief Justice of Pakistan, Supreme Court Judges, and High Court Chief Justices and Judges.
clauses: Article Fifth Schedule establishes the statutory provisions governing remuneration and terms and conditions of service of judges under the Constitution of Pakistan.
